dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Required. One row per period: a date, or a text/number such as 2026-01, Q1 2026, 2026.

dataRoles.name: periodSortKey
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric or date key (e.g. 202601) from the same table as Period, used for chronological sorting.

dataRoles.name: primaryValue
dataRoles.description: Required. Main figure of the tile (Actual, Projected or any business measure).

dataRoles.name: secondaryValue
dataRoles.description: Optional smaller figure shown under the primary value.

dataRoles.name: secondaryLabel
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the secondary value label (e.g. Actual).

dataRoles.name: actualValue
dataRoles.description: Recommended. Realised value per period, drawn as the main bar.

dataRoles.name: projectedValue
dataRoles.description: Optional projected total for the open period.

dataRoles.name: projectionRemaining
dataRoles.description: Optional. MAX(0, Projected - Actual), stacked on top of Actual for the open period.

dataRoles.name: previousYearValue
dataRoles.description: Recommended. Same period of the previous year.

dataRoles.name: targetValue
dataRoles.description: Optional target.

dataRoles.name: targetVariance
dataRoles.description: Optional variance to target (absolute or %), shown when 'Show target variance' is on.

dataRoles.name: comparison1Value
dataRoles.description: Optional first variance (e.g. vs previous period). Number or prepared text.

dataRoles.name: comparison1Label
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the first comparison label.

dataRoles.name: comparison2Value
dataRoles.description: Optional second variance (e.g. vs same period last year). Number or prepared text.

dataRoles.name: comparison2Label
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the second comparison label.

dataRoles.name: statusValue
dataRoles.description: Optional value compared with the badge thresholds (e.g. variance to target, -0.03 = -3%).

dataRoles.name: statusCode
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure: ON_TARGET, NEAR_TARGET, BELOW_TARGET, ABOVE_TARGET, NO_TARGET, NO_DATA, CUSTOM.

dataRoles.name: statusLabel
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure overriding the badge text.

dataRoles.name: isCurrentPeriod
dataRoles.description: Recommended. 1/TRUE for the open (in progress) period, 0/FALSE otherwise.

dataRoles.name: kpiTechnicalName
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure, e.g. RET-001.

dataRoles.name: kpiTitle
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the title.

dataRoles.name: kpiSubtitle
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the subtitle.

dataRoles.name: kpiCategory
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure for the category shown top right.

dataRoles.name: actionUrl
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure returning an https:// URL used by the 'Open URL' actions.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Optional additional measures displayed in tooltips.
